title: STNFS at relation excess 1.1 with line sieve to 2^48 and band strip, f-first ECM, weight-200 merge, ten LA owners, sub-bin pr, skewed boot, fresh on-region pool, joint table-good-event control: 120.254755005279

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm (proof.md, DESCENT.md, REFINEMENT.md) with 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, required relation excess 1.1 (the whole region is collected; every retained relation, >= 2^63.6890 = 1.179 U, is filtered and used by the descent; the matrix is charged at excess 1.1, an over-estimate of N), theta = 2347/8000 collection on a fresh 164,000-draw pool at theta 5/16 (rows with qa < 0.02 give no yield, cells still charged), the measured record route, recentred slice12 kernels (KERNELS.md), f-first early abort, the weight-200 merge and the STORAGE.md/row_tail.c kernels with ten active owners returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.39 under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (H4u: >= 88% of filtered row weight is +-1, measured at weights 100/200, excess 1.1; weight-200 ratio <= 0.80 and N/U not rising above the measured 2^15..2^18 values are part of H3). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^120.254755005279 dense-Fp12 units, C=20,000 instructions, with upper-rounded ledger rows summing to 2^120.2547550052780235 (70-digit decimal arithmetic), below the declared 2^120.254755005279. ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime; theta=2347/8000 (16247 rows, a-radius 784; relations >= 2^63.6890, 0.1002 bits = 2.01 pool SE above 1.1 U; descent input 63.589 = estimate - 2 SE) with slacks (295, 226), allowance 1.0165, line sieve (scores only) below 2^48 and record walk for [2^48, 2^64), survivors stripping (2^20, 2^48] primes by two 48-bit ECM rounds per side (a miss loses the relation, charged in the yield), alpha (5.15, 0.85), primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at 10.01 and re-read at 7.003; g-side band strip and ECM run only after f factors, with probability q_f = 100 rho(u_f)/P(omitted_f <= slack_f) per row: collection <= 2^119.9317 units (309.4 instructions per cell). The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target are the cited source's; the 62-node descent plan (90d99567 re-optimised at sub-bin pr, skewed boot, LOG2_RELS = 63.599, re-evaluated at 63.589: 41 entries move; refinement.json) is evaluated at UDUP = 0.65, THIN_MAX 85 and PHI_FLOOR 0.03. Linear algebra (mean weight 201, 20.7 per sparse entry, 1,640 per row, 97 per dense term, 420 per 9-limb reduction, N = 0.80 x 1.1192 x 0.0550025 U = 2^59.1075 < 10 x 2^56 at excess 1.1, blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^117.7346 units, generator <= 2^107.0897. Descent credits UDUP = 0.65 distinct relations per raw relation at the boot (E[shat/m]/pr_charged >= 0.87, complete-orbit recount; boot reduced in the weighted metric, certified exactly); at nodes each reachable class's per-lattice exact-orbit yield law is bounded inside the recurrence (S*: 49 classes incl. composite missing-log nodes, pre-registered 40,800-lattice campaign, Bonferroni 95%), discards at the 30 thin nodes (all 8 with q < 2^90 via THIN_MAX 85 plus 22 plan-flagged thin=1: 90f 90g 95g 100f 100g 105f 105g 110f 110g 115f 120f 120g 130f 130g 135f 135g 145f 145g 170f 175f 205f 220f; missing ideals descend at the other 32 in Q q' lattices with N(Q q') in [2^89, 2^90)), and keeps 24 boot relations. Expected two-log work on the table-good event is bounded by 2^113.158; the two-log meter is 2^115.0; Markov abort probability is <= 0.279. Other upper bounds are boot failure 1.0e-04 per log on the good event (modelled 9.91e-05), expected nodes 2^17.68, node abort 2^-9.62 and repeats 2^-10.70 and the table-good-event delta 0.24 (McDiarmid-max 1e-9 + Markov 0.230894 + union 1e-9), with 2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failures, advice, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing amortized. Certificate construction gets an extra 2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most 2^105 bytes. Source smoothness and production extrapolations stay explicit heuristics. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded evidence, ledger, success, window endpoints and integration controls; no full-recurrence rerun.
Rerun filtsim.py at excess 1.1 (optional 'excess') to mean weight 100/200 (default 200); report +-1 row-weight fraction (vs 0.88) and U/N. Optional; evidence at its scale only (H4u, H3).
Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger, retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (~125 s natively; longer emulated).
